|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Jeroen Webb (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB2-92-Jeroen_Webb-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Jeroen Webb (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Jeroen Webb (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “If deploying to opponent's mobile site, deploys -2 as an Undercover spy. Nevar Yalnal may not target spies here. Opponent's total influence here is -1 for each of your spies at sites.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Jeroen Webb (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “deploys -2 as an Undercover spy” to “deploys as an Undercover spy (deploy -2)” and “may not target spies here” to “may not target spies at Webb's site”: “If deploying to opponent's mobile site, deploys as an Undercover spy (deploy -2). Nevar Yalnal may not target spies at Webb's site. Opponent's total influence here is -1 for each of your spies at sites.”.<ref name="cl-1220_92-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
